diagnosis: Customer requests procedure for resetting API token on a startup-tier Unified Auth account. Account uses scoped keys per KB-0003; no credentials are managed account-wide. The reply must direct the customer to create a replacement key, migrate traffic, then revoke the old key. No escalation needed.
reply: Thank you for your request. Because your account uses Unified Auth, you manage credentials as scoped API keys rather than a single account-wide token. The correct procedure is: 1) Create a new scoped key with the required permissions in your account settings, 2) Update your ETL job to use the new key, and 3) Once traffic has moved to the new key, revoke the old key. Please note that revocation takes effect immediately, so ensure your ETL job is stable on the new key before removing the old one. If you need additional assistance, please let us know.
